signature: fuse_predictions(whole, tiled, image_size, min_side_threshold=16.0, nms_iou=0.7, confidence_floor=0.001, max_detections=1000, fusion_mode="global_nms", containment_ratio=0.9)

input.whole: dict: xyxy list[N,4] and confidence list[N] in original-image pixels
input.tiled: same format, already mapped to original-image pixels and ownership filtered
input.image_size: (width,height) of the actual oriented inference image

output: same xyxy/confidence dict; one class only
APPolicy: Retain source confidence>=0.001 for AP; apply0.3 only when scoring operating-point counts/P/R. Do not substitute confidence_floor0.3 then claim untruncated AP.
gateUnits: predicted minimum box side times1024/max(image width,height)
publicClaimLimit: Do not call this a validated improvement or strict SAHI reproduction.
